Extremely Disappointed with KPMG's Recruitment and Background Verification Process
I am writing this review to express my profound dissatisfaction with KPMG's recruitment and background verification (BGV) process. Despite successfully completing all formalities and receiving an offer, my profile was rejected during the BGV without any prior notification or clear justification.
Here are the key points of my experience:
Lack of Communication: After receiving the offer, I was informed that my profile did not pass the BGV. This decision was made without any prior notification or opportunity to rectify any supposed issues.
Unjustified Rejection: The rejection was based on a mistake in the uploaded documents, which could have been clarified if I had been given the chance. Despite my repeated requests to re-verify the documents, the recruiter did not respond or provide any assistance.
Professional and Personal Impact: Trusting KPMG's offer, I resigned from my previous job. Now, I find myself unemployed with significant financial commitments and responsibilities towards my family. This situation has caused immense stress and uncertainty.
Unresponsive Recruiter: Throughout this ordeal, the recruiter handling my case was unresponsive and dismissive of my requests for clarification and assistance. This lack of professionalism is unacceptable from a reputed firm like KPMG.
I urge KPMG's higher authorities to review and address this issue to prevent such occurrences in the future. Job candidates invest significant time and trust in your recruitment process, and they deserve fair treatment and clear communication.
This experience has severely impacted my trust in KPMG, and I hope no other candidate has to go through such an ordeal.

benefits.name: Flexible work options
benefits.details: KPMG in India recognises the need to balance personal and family commitments with your work, by giving you more say over how, when and where your work gets done. Options include variation to office-hours, part-time work, working from home and gradual re-entry/exit arrangements.

benefits.name: Health and Wellbeing
benefits.details: Good health and wellbeing help you maintain a fulfilling personal life and enhance your contribution towards professional performance. Our Wellbeing program covers a range of relevant benefits including annual health examinations and life balance toolkit with 24*7 access to counsellers for employees and their family members to deal with issues related to mental health, anxiety, anger management, self-confidence, marital distress, smoking/alcohol addiction and others that maybe affecting their overall wellbeing.

benefits.name: Insurance cover
benefits.details: Employees are covered under Group Term Life insurance, Mediclaim and Accident insurance. Employees can also opt for additional insurance support like the recently introduced COVID-19 coverage.

benefits.name: Workplace health and safety
benefits.details: With our efforts to ensure utmost safety at workplace, employees are provided with a user-friendly application also allowing them to book and check-in to their seat upon visit to office.

benefits.name: Personal time-off
benefits.details: KPMG in India promotes work-life balance by offering progressive leave benefits and time-off opportunities tailored to employee needs. These include shared leave, which allows colleagues to support each other during medical emergencies; primary caregiver leave, ensuring gender-neutral paid time off for childcare; adoption maternity leave, providing support to women employees adopting a child; and sabbatical leave, enabling extended unpaid time-off for personal growth or exigencies, all reflecting the firm’s commitment to inclusivity, flexibility, and employee well-being.
